RaMP multi-database ORA (KEGG map00350, FDR = 2.98e-09, fold enrichment 626.6) ranked tyrosine metabolism first, driven by four input metabolites — L-tyrosine (CHEBI:17895), catechol (CHEBI:18135), (R)-noradrenaline (CHEBI:18357), and L-homocysteine (CHEBI:17588) — with the latter linking tyrosine and homocysteine metabolism via transsulfuration. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA independently returned hsa00350 at the top (p = 0.0065), citing L-tyrosine and noradrenaline.
